# Bail Bond Release Center of the Palm Beaches

> Licensed Florida bail bond agency (license P204302) serving West Palm Beach and all of Palm Beach County, plus Martin County and St. Lucie County, Florida, 24 hours a day, 365 days a year. Bilingual service in English and Spanish.

- Office: 800 S. Congress Ave., West Palm Beach, FL 33406
- Phone: 561-833-4388 (24/7). Text: 561-531-8622
- Email: bailbondreleasecenter@gmail.com
- Premium: set by Florida law at 10 percent of the bond amount
- Jails served: Palm Beach County Main Detention Center, 3228 Gun Club Road, West Palm Beach; West Detention Center, 38811 James Wheeler Way, Belle Glade; Martin County Jail, Stuart; St. Lucie County Jail, Fort Pierce
- Areas: West Palm Beach, Riviera Beach, Palm Beach Gardens, Jupiter, Tequesta, Boca Raton, Delray Beach, Boynton Beach, Lake Worth Beach, Lantana, Greenacres, Wellington, Royal Palm Beach, Loxahatchee, Belle Glade, Pahokee, South Bay; Martin County: Stuart, Palm City, Jensen Beach, Hobe Sound, Indiantown; St. Lucie County: Port St. Lucie, Fort Pierce, Tradition
- Online: co-signer and defendant bail applications can be started on this site
